# Validation

Local checks: `node .local-tests/run.cjs`. Tests stay outside Git through the global exclude file. No console access is needed.

A prior FS206 RomFS read succeeded after license preparation. Confirm ExeFS, RomFS, HTTP and WebDAV on the target console. Check NCA export and cancellation separately.

Keep the repositories private until the owner approves publication. See [console storage policy](CONSOLE-ACCESS.md).
